items.text: Create something new: You will together with us to implement great new ideas and bring innovative features to the market.

Help shape the future: You will work in a large variety of video security related areas, including Linux kernel and driver programming, based on different platforms like ARM and specialized Video SoC (System on Chip).
Experience cooperation: You will work together with other developers in different countries and be part of an international community.
Continuous Improvement: Ability with your team for continuously improvement on infrastructure, workflow and cooperation
Working Practice: Ability to analyze and debug complex problems for the HW bring-up and product maintenance
Experience and Knowledge: Deep knowledge in embedded Linux systems on Linux Kernel. Good knowledge of the device tree, shell script, and Git.
Languages: Good in written and spoken English.
Education: Successfully completed University degree in computer science or related technical discipline.
Teamwork: Works collaboratively with others to achieve shared goals and maintain a positive team environment.
Motivation: Likes learning new skills and proactively seeks opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.
